product_family: Notion Calendar - a standalone calendar application for desktop (macOS, Windows) and mobile (iOS, Android) that integrates with Notion workspaces and external calendar services (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, Zoom).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: The SOC 2 Type 2 is an audit report performed by an independent third-party certified by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Notion holds certifications for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and ISO 27701, which outline requirements for establishing, implementing, and continuously improving Notion's Information Security Management System (ISMS) and Privacy Information Management System (PIMS).

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: Notion holds certifications for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and ISO 27701

certifications.name: ISO 27701
certifications.proof_quote: Notion holds certifications for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and ISO 27701

certifications.name: BSI C5
certifications.proof_quote: Notion is certified under this German cloud security standard

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Notion has a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) that applies to the extent Notion processes Personal Data subject to the GDPR on a customer's behalf. Notion's Data Processing Addendum incorporates both the EU and UK Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: To enable HIPAA compliance for Notion Calendar, you must enable HIPAA compliance with Google Workspace. Notion Calendar can support HIPAA compliance, but with specific requirements and Enterprise Plan subscription with Business Associate Agreement.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification found in Notion's official security documentation

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification found in Notion's official security documentation

privacy.ai_training_note: By default, Notion and its AI Subprocessors do not use Customer Data to train any models. AI Subprocessors are prohibited from using Customer Data to train models. Notion Calendar data is not used for model training purposes.
privacy.data_region: Notion does not publicly specify default data residency regions, though they support GDPR-compliant data transfers with Standard Contractual Clauses for EU/UK data.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Yes - industry standard TLS/SSL encryption for all data in transit

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Yes - customer data encrypted at rest

security.name: Third-party calendar integration
security.value: Calendar data stored and managed via third-party APIs (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple). Notion stores userID and authorization tokens to facilitate API access. Third-party providers are Non-Notion Services subject to their own security policies.

security.name: Google API compliance
security.value: Notion Calendar's use of Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including Limited Use requirements

security.name: Data access controls
security.value: Workspace-level access controls. Workspace admins control member permissions and data sharing.

products.name: Notion Calendar
products.data_scope: Calendar events, meeting details, scheduling information, task deadlines, project timelines, participant data. Integrations with third-party calendar services (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar) and conferencing tools (Google Meet, Zoom).
products.notes: Available as standalone app (macOS, Windows, iOS, Android). Free tier available. Enterprise plan required for HIPAA compliance. Fully integrated with Notion workspace to view database items (deadlines, timelines) alongside calendar events.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium - free tier available; enterprise plans available for organizations needing HIPAA compliance and advanced security features
compare.data_residency: Cloud-hosted on Notion's infrastructure; supports EU/UK data residency via GDPR SCCs; specific region options not publicly documented

flags: Notion Calendar relies on third-party calendar integrations (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple) for core functionality. Compliance and security depend partly on those providers' own security posture.
HIPAA support requires Google Workspace HIPAA compliance. Customers must verify that their Google Workspace configuration meets HIPAA requirements separately.

Calendar data integrations with third-party services are classified as 'Non-Notion Services' in the privacy policy. Notion is transparent about this boundary but customers should understand the shared responsibility model.

No explicit mention of Notion Calendar in the SOC 2 Type 2 audit report scope, though Calendar is a first-party Notion product tightly integrated with core infrastructure and covered under Notion's privacy policy. Organizations requiring explicit Calendar inclusion in audit scope should contact Notion directly.
